# Lab Journal - Social Networks

Last compiled on October 2026

Welcome to my lab journal! On this website, I document my progress for the Social Networks course. I have my progress per week, as well as my final assignment, divided in chapters.

*Use the top menu to navigate through the journal.*

<br>

## Open Science

Everyone can fork this repository. Use this example to journal your lab work and assignments.
